result:
I've finished the A half of round 180 (DUX-R-5b-3b). Nothing is committed or pushed, and the browser rows are still C's to run.

**Baseline.** HEAD was `15189d5`, the 997 frozen files matched, and the 6 granted files matched their start hashes. The 13 base test files passed 242/242 before I edited anything.

**What changed.** Exactly the 6 granted files plus the 2 new ones (`git status` shows 6 modified and 2 untracked):
- **`ArrangementLane.tsx` and `ArrangementLibraryPreview.tsx`:** only class swaps at the sites B listed. Valid drag feedback is now `foreground` and blocked feedback is `muted`. The drop hint is always `text-foreground` and became a plain `className`. The video import and Preview "Add" buttons now use `border-outline-strong` with `text-foreground`. Focus rings and the active-track tint (`bg-brand/5`) are unchanged.
- **Three existing tests (L1–L3):** they now expect the new tokens, and the old brass tokens were added to their exclusion lists. Nothing was loosened.
- **New test file `drag-feedback-colour-ui.test.tsx`:** 7 tests (DXG1–DXG7). It never finds elements by colour class, and every lookup that can miss throws a labelled error.
- **Docs:** doc 147 is marked Completed with the round-179 notes. Doc 148 is new, written in Georgian, with status `In Progress (awaiting C round 180)`.

**Checks I ran.**
- The 14 targeted test files pass 249/249: the 13 base files give the same 242, and the new file gives 7.
- `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` both exit 0; lint's warnings were already there, and none are in the changed files.
- Biome on the 6 code and test files: no errors.
- I did not run the full suite, verify, build or e2e; under the speed rules those belong to the root gate.

**Mutations m291–m298.** Each one was applied, tested, restored and checked by hash. Two results differ from B's expectations, and in both cases the tests are stricter than B predicted:
- **m294:** DXG7 also turns red, because it requires `ring-muted` on the refused ring.
- **m296:** the existing import-button test in `lane-strings-ui` also turns red. B expected it to stay green, but it already checks the compact button's colours.

**Code review.** The `code-reviewer` subagent ran and scored it 9/10, with nothing at Medium or above. I fixed four of its Low findings in the new test file, then reran the tests and mutations; the results were unchanged. Three Lows are left for B:
- Some lookups go through the DOM structure (a row's parent element, `aria-controls`, the clip's id attribute) rather than role, name, text or test id only. None uses a colour class.
- Two assertions in DXG3 can never fail.
- Doc 147 still has an old TODO that should be struck through. B's task said to change nothing else in that doc, so I left it.

Its Architecture note is copied word for word into the report.

**Other notes for B and C.**
- **Process deviation:** two edits to the new test file were made with a Python string replacement instead of the Edit tool. The final file was fully re-verified afterwards.
- **For C:** when a clip move is refused on the Video lane, two ghosts appear at once: the blocked one and the last valid one. C's CC-DRAG check should expect both.
- **Ableton:** whether these colours match Live is unverified, since no source was checked this round.

The full report, with the exact next checks for C, is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-180.md`. Supporting files are in `a-round-180/`: `end-sha256.txt`, `diff-vs-start.patch`, `vitest-files.txt` and `mutations/`. The backlog is not marked complete.
